sloka: खरस्य निधने देवि जनस्थान वधम् प्रति ।राक्षसा विविधा वाचो व्यवहरन्ति महावने ॥३-४५-१९॥
transliteration: kharasya nidhane devi janasthāna vadham prati ।rākṣasā vividhā vāco vyavaharanti mahāvane ॥3-45-19॥

translations.english: These demons wander about tormenting others and spreading rumours of all kinds. You need not worry about them.
